info.description: A modern, agent-friendly frontend for the Python Package Index. Every JSON endpoint listed here that has a `.txt` sibling also honours `Accept: text/plain`, returning the plain-text representation instead. All responses are cacheable; requests are rate limited to 30 req/s (burst 60) per client, which is reported via the RateLimit-* headers and a 429 response.
info.title: pypx API
